description: Agent Bookkeeping: submit journal entries with the open period they post to: the journal with its reference, its currency, the first and last day of the open period, each suspense or clearing account the books keep, and each entry with its id, entry number, date, memo, the entry number it reverses where it is a reversing entry, and each line with its account and its debit or credit. The signed report gives the journal, each entry’s debits against its credits, each entry date against the open period, each reversing entry against the entry it reverses with the accounts and amounts mirrored, each entry posted to a suspense or clearing account, and the entries that are a round thousand or dated on a weekend, and counts them, and names a divergent journal: an entry whose debits do not equal its credits, an entry dated outside the open period, a reversal pair left unmatched, and an entry parked in suspense; then a round-dollar entry, a weekend posting and a repeated entry number, which are patterns that call for a second look, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No entries, no lines with debits or credits, or no open period or entry dates leaves those points unverified, and a journal with no reversing entry leaves the reversal pairs unread. Amounts compare to the cent, dates by the day, accounts by their number or words, and a round amount is a whole thousand of at least one thousand. This reads the journal entries as written, line by line and entry by entry. Verdict bookkeeping_journal_divergent, bookkeeping_journal_partial, bookkeeping_journal_unverified or bookkeeping_journal_consistent. POST /api/bookkeeping-journal-check. Reads the bookkeeping records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the books as supplied only: it never posts or edits an entry, never moves money or pays a bill, never files anything with any authority and gives no tax advice, which stay with the business, its bookkeeper and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Bookkeeping reads a business’s own books for internal consistency and against the records they should agree with: a general-ledger extract, a bank reconciliation, journal entries, a chart of accounts, a period close, the accounts payable ledger, a payroll register and the accounts receivable ledger, each against its own debits and credits, the source totals supplied, the bank statement and the ledger balance, the open period, the posting queue and recurring entries, or the ledger postings and pay schedule it should agree with. The family reads bookkeeping, the record a business keeps of its own transactions in its ledger and journals, and reads the records against each other. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-bookkeeping-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-bookkeeping/.
